correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the first-step recurrence (|I|+beta*m)F=1+sum_recoveries F+beta*sum_transmissions F on disjoint susceptible/infectious subsets. Every transition decreases lexicographically (|S|,|I|), so the exact rational recursion terminates. Independently enumerated all simple graphs on n=1,...,4, quotiented connected graphs under vertex permutations (1,1,2,6 classes), and exactly differentiated F for each of 33 rooted connected representatives: numerator and denominator of every derivative have nonnegative coefficients, and numerator is nonzero for n>1. Disconnected components reduce to the rooted component. Independently computed the five-vertex K2+3 isolates graph at beta=100, seed3: F=3233110817579844486927395030461/1415931898971338608037919183261, exceeding H5=137/60 by exactly 1326298572426638149591240301/28318637979426772160758383665220>0. The high-transmission limit follows by a spanning-tree transmission-time coupling and uniform integrability against the sum of infectious lifetimes. This establishes a sharp counterexample, not a full five-vertex classification.
residual_risks: The independent symbolic certificate is finite exhaustive only through n=4, as required; no claim about all n>=5. General high-rate convergence uses the specified independent exponential lifetime coupling.

value.rationale: The minimal network order for a qualitative reversal in an epidemic observable is a natural structural boundary: all rooted networks up to four nodes obey a monotone law, while the explicit cyclic five-node witness violates it. The single time-expectation invariant is mechanistically meaningful and the cutoff is not automatic from previously studied models. A modest sharp finite threshold is mathematically valuable without purporting to predict actual outbreaks.
residual_risks: Relevance is limited to homogeneous one-seed Markov SIR with expected total infectious duration.

limitations: One-seed continuous-time homogeneous SIR, undirected unweighted graphs; n<=4 exhaustive theorem and a single n=5 existence witness, no all-n classification.
